name: Nadine
source:
Kyonyuu Fantasy 2:
Queen. As a king's wife she doesn't hold any political power, but has considerable influence in the court.

Kyonyuu Fantasy 2 if:
Younger sister of the King, holds no political power but has considerable influence over the King. Due to marry the next King
